# GuessHog

> Guess Who, but every face is a PostHog hedgehog. A free, two-player guessing game that runs in the browser at https://guesshog.posthog.com. Made by PostHog.

## How to play

1. Create a room at https://guesshog.posthog.com and send the four-letter room code (or the invite link, https://guesshog.posthog.com/r/CODE) to a friend.
2. Two people take the Player 1 and Player 2 seats. Anyone else in the room is a spectator and sees both boards and both secret hogs.
3. Each player gets a secret hog from a shared board of 24 hedgehogs, picked at random from the solo hoggies in the @posthog/brand package.
4. Players take turns. On your turn, type a yes-or-no question. The other player answers with Yes or No, and then it's their turn.
5. Flip down the hogs your opponent's hog can't be. Each player can see which positions the other has flipped down, but not their secret.
6. On your turn you can guess instead of asking. A right guess wins the round. A wrong guess loses it.

## Links

- Play: https://guesshog.posthog.com
- Source code: https://github.com/PostHog/guesshog
